prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished premium indie-game cover key art for Unity Play, one opaque landscape 16:9 cover, target 1920x1080 framing. This is promotional cover art, not a screenshot or an interface mockup.
Input images: Image 1 is the blue robot's exact CHARACTER IDENTITY reference. Image 2 is the orange robot's exact CHARACTER IDENTITY reference. Image 3 is the approved PONG LOGO identity and typography reference. Image 4 is a WORLD/MATERIAL/PALETTE reference only, supplying the grass arena and dark navy lamp-lined masonry; ignore all its UI and composition.
Primary request: a striking polished pixel-art action poster that makes this robot Pong game look exciting and instantly recognizable at thumbnail size.
Composition: very strong three-subject hierarchy: enormous clean PONG logo centered across the upper third; large BLUE robot across the left foreground; large ORANGE robot across the right foreground. Low heroic camera angle with energetic diagonal staging. Both robots are rivals facing slightly inward in dynamic tennis-ready action poses, bodies leaning toward the center, expressive glowing vertical eyes and big appealing helmet/visor shapes. Their oval tennis rackets frame a single small brilliant white/silver Pong ball in the lower central negative space. Neither racket nor character overlaps or obscures the logo. Subjects fill the image with strong silhouettes but keep title and both faces within comfortable safe margins for thumbnails.
Preserve each character's recognizable small rounded white cap/helmet with colored stripe and visor brim, glossy deep black face screen with two rectangular vertical glowing eyes, white segmented armor, colored shoulder/ear plates, colored gloves/boots and matching oval racket with visible dark string lattice. Blue robot has only blue/cyan accent color; orange robot has only orange/amber accent color. Keep their friendly compact proportions and the exact original design language; enhance pose and dramatic pixel shading without redesigning them as giant armored mechs, human athletes or smooth 3D toys.
Background: a atmospheric night version of their pixel grass arena, understated dark emerald grass at the bottom, a few receding white court lines and a low dark navy stone border with lamps. Deep navy shadow behind the title. Electric cyan rim light and sparse squared pixel sparks/speed strokes behind the blue character, warm amber rim light and sparse squared sparks/speed strokes behind the orange character. Two subtle sweeping colored energy trails lead the viewer toward the ball, creating strong movement and depth. Controlled light bloom only around energy, eyes and ball, not a foggy wash; enough quiet dark space to separate subjects. Rich luminous color against dark background, polished energetic arcade poster mood.
Logo: exact single word "PONG", enormous bold bright white/silver chunky beveled pixel letters with thick deep navy shadow/extrusion, matching image 3. The O is its recognizable shaded silver ball. Thin precise cyan and orange outer accents, keep color regions clean and natural junctions; top cyan shorter/orange longer, lower cyan longer/orange shorter. Logo is legible at small size and fully contained in the picture.
Style: premium hand-crafted detailed pixel-art illustration with crisp intentional stair-step contours, square pixel clusters and carefully shaded metal, consistent with the game's existing robots; cinematic artwork but unmistakably pixel art. Clear focused foreground, relatively simple background; do not pack every power-up into the cover.
Constraints: only the word PONG, no subtitles, no slogans, no badges, no publisher logos, no Unity branding, no UI buttons, no scoreboards or timer, no screenshots, no loading screen, no extra characters, no giant explosion, no unrelated weapons, no watermark, no border around the whole image. Balanced professional cover art, one cohesive scene, landscape 16:9.
processing: Preserve original master; center-crop only the tiny outer margin to exact 16:9, nearest-neighbor resize for crisp pixel edges; export opaque PNG and quality-95 JPEG.
